Vendored for offline use. Do not load these from a CDN.

- three.js r186 (campus/vendor/three.module.js, three.core.js) — MIT
- three.js r186 postprocessing examples (campus/vendor/three-post/: EffectComposer, RenderPass, UnrealBloomPass, and their Pass/shader dependencies) — MIT. Copied from the r186 tag and retargeted to the local three.module.js. No CDN.
- d3 7.9.0 (campus/vendor/d3.js) — ISC
- anime.js 4.5.0 (campus/vendor/anime.js) — MIT
- rough.js 4.6.6 (campus/vendor/rough.js) — MIT
- canvas-confetti 1.9.3 (campus/vendor/confetti.js) — ISC
- markmap-lib and markmap-view 0.18.12, bundled with d3 (campus/vendor/markmap.js) — MIT

Mermaid 11.12.0 is MIT and is used only at build time. The site ships the generated SVGs in campus/assets/mermaid/. GSAP is not vendored.
